In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover a two major stories shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
Story 1: India’s Rooftop Solar Challenge
We will look into why rooftop solar adoption in India remains low despite strong consumer interest. The story explores the gap between people wanting solar panels and actually installing them, along with the hidden issue of poor maintenance that reduces power generation even after installation. It also highlights the policy, awareness, and business opportunities shaping India’s rooftop solar future.
